what_this_is: An email provider description for this sign-in tool (settings email.sender): the one request that sends a message, the credential its auth header carries named by vault handle (`vault_key`, never its value; the sign-in unit loads it as a sealed credential of that name), where an accepted answer holds the message id and where a refusal holds its reason. A computer row names this file in its sign-in unit's settings_parts (tools/better-auth-official/email-providers/resend.json); another provider is another file and no code change. Which domain sends is the sender's own: its DNS signs for it (resend._domainkey TXT, the send. subdomain's SPF and MX), and the address is the computer row's settings email.from.
name: Resend
